defs.def: a class or group of people or things that share particular qualities or features and are part of a larger group; a kind or sort 类型；种类

ex.s: This type of rereading is called regression.
ex.t: 这种重读类型被称为回视。

ex.s: The 21st century has created a whole range of new types of professionals that we have never had before — or if not quite new, at least newly repackaged.
ex.t: 21世纪创造了一系列我们前所未有新型职业——即便不算全新，至少也是被重新包装过的。

ex.s: Additionally, the research didn’t include all types of plastics.
ex.t: 此外，该研究没有包括所有类型的塑料。

ex.s: The team focused only on three common types — polystyrene, polyethylene and polypropylene — and they didn’t study other chemicals previously found in water such as vinyl chloride.
ex.t: 团队只关注三种常见类型——聚苯乙烯、聚乙烯和聚丙烯——且没研究之前在水中发现的其他化学品如氯乙烯。

ex.s: The type of plastic in water.
ex.t: 水中塑料的种类.

ex.s: Library Type Loan Cost Article/Chapter Cost
ex.t: 图书馆类型 借阅费用 文章/章节费用

ex.s: Though they are useful for detecting shifts in the number and variety of species in an area, a new Stanford study has found that this type of record is not perfect.
ex.t: 尽管它们有助于发现一个地区物种数量和种类的变化，斯坦福的一项新研究发现这类记录并不完美。

ex.s: Each type of literature has its unique end.
ex.t: 每一种文学都有其独特的结局.

ex.s: It of offers many types of bikes.
ex.t: 它提供许多类型的自行车。

ex.s: To compare different types of park-goers.
ex.t: 比较不同种类的游乐园者.

ex.s: Taking too many types of exercises.
ex.t: 练习太多

ex.s: Train trips aren’t for impatient types.
ex.t: 火车出行并非不耐烦。

ex.s: The reason is simple: we know of just one type of life and it’s challenging to do science with a sample size of one.
ex.t: 原因很简单：我们只知道一种生命，而用样本量为一来做科学是很有挑战性的。

ex.s: It suits the audience and the purpose and gets the job done. ____15____ This type of writing won’t be rewarded by the school examiner, nor by a future employer or a potential client.
ex.t: 它适合读者和目的并且完成了任务。____15____这种类型的写作不会得到学校考官的奖励，也不会被未来的雇主或潜在客户认可。

ex.s: This depends on the type of book you are reading.
ex.t: 这取决于你正在读的书的类型。

ex.s: ●Put different types of clothing on different surfaces in the room.____19____.
ex.t: * 在房间的不同表面放置不同类型的____19____衣服。

ex.s: Due to 65 growing popularity of environmentally-related and adventure travel, various types 66 trips are now being classified as ecotourism.
ex.t: 由于与环境相关和探险旅行的日益流行，各种类型的66旅行现在被归类为生态旅游。

ex.s: He realised that something needed to change, and, being a London media type, appointed himself "marketing director for Nature".
ex.t: 他意识到必须做出改变，而作为一名伦敦媒体人，他自封为“大自然营销总监”。

ex.s: Typing your poem out.
ex.t: 把诗打出来

ex.s: However, a variety of types is represented here.
ex.t: 然而，这里呈现了多种多样的类型。

ex.s: Including various types of plays.
ex.t: 包括各类剧目.

ex.s: Dr Rowan, ______ secretary resigned two weeks ago, has had to do all his own typing. （    ）
ex.t: 罗恩博士，____秘书两周前辞职了，不得不自己打所有字。（    ）

ex.s: The keyboard could offer a strong layer of security by analyzing things like the force of a user's typing and the time between key presses.
ex.t: 键盘可以通过分析诸如用户敲击的力度和按键间隔等，提供一层强大的安全性。

ex.s: It also doesn't require a new type of technology that people aren't already familiar with.
ex.t: 它也不需要人们尚不熟悉的新技术。

ex.s: Everybody uses a keyboard and everybody types differently.
ex.t: 人人都用键盘，而且每个人的打字方式都不同。

ex.s: To improve accuracy in typing
ex.t: 提高打字的准确性

ex.s: It'll help speed up typing.
ex.t: 有助于加快打字速度.

ex.s: Most of my reading through primary， middle and high school was factual reading． I read for knowledge， and to make A's on my tests． Occasionally， I would read a novel that was assigned， but I didn't enjoy this type of reading． I liked facts， things that are concrete． I thought anything abstract left too much room for argument．
ex.t: 我小学、初中和高中的阅读大多是事实性阅读。我为获取知识而读，也为考试拿A而读。偶尔我会读被布置的小说，但我不喜欢这类阅读。我喜欢事实、具体的事物。我觉得任何抽象的东西都留给争论太多空间。

ex.s: Ocean colour varies from green to blue，depending on the type and concentration of phytoplankton.
ex.t: 海洋颜色从绿到蓝不等，取决于浮游植物的类型和浓度。

ex.s: “Not only are the quantities of phytoplankton in the ocean changing. ”she said，“but the type of phytoplankton is changing. ”
ex.t: “不仅是海洋中浮游植物的数量在变化，”她说，“浮游植物的类型也在变化。”

ex.s: Many visitors were amazed by the complex architectural space and abundant building types.
ex.t: 许多游客对复杂的建筑空间和丰富的建筑类型感到惊叹。

ex.s: Through such a balance, he had created a new type of Chinese architecture, said Tadao Ando, the winner of the 1995 Pritzker Prize.
ex.t: 1995年普利兹克奖得主安藤忠雄说，通过这种平衡，他创造了一种新型的中国建筑。

ex.s: Today, on an island in the Pacific, a specific type of shell still serves as currency — and some people there are even hoarding it, just like Bitcoin moguls, convinced that one day, it will make them wealthy beyond imagination.
ex.t: 今天，在太平洋的一个岛上，一种特定的贝壳仍被当作货币——那里有些人甚至像比特币大亨一样囤积它，坚信有一天它会让他们富得超乎想象。

ex.s: And just like crypto currencies, there are those who think the islanders are smart to invest in this type of money, which is reported to have risen in value over the last three decades.
ex.t: 就像加密货币一样，也有人认为岛民投资这类货币是明智的，据报道其价值在过去三十年里已经上涨。

ex.s: But some types of situations can help us to get rid of the occurrence of anger.
ex.t: 但有些情境能帮我们消除愤怒的发生。

ex.s: To design new types of cars.
ex.t: 设计新型汽车.

ex.s: From now on I will only be editing articles for PsyBlog while wearing a white coat to help keep the typing error count low.
ex.t: 从现在起，我只会在穿着白大褂的情况下编辑PsyBlog的文章，以帮助减少打字错误的数量。

defs.def: a person of a particular character, with particular features, etc. 具有某种特征的人；典型

ex.s: Although parks of all sizes and types exist at any level, the national parks, in particular, tend ____41____ (catch) our attention because of their large size and variety.
ex.t: 虽然各级都有各种规模和类型的公园,但国家公园由于其____41____规模大,种类繁多,尤其引起我们的注意。

ex.s: *Fill out desired information:location, job type, etc
ex.t: * 填写想要的信息:地点、工作类型等

ex.s: Typing patterns vary from person to person.
ex.t: 打字模式因人而异.

defs.def: having the qualities or features of the group, person or thing mentioned 构成形容词
letters that are printed or typed （印刷或打印的）文字，字体，字型

ex.s: Lancom cares about you and addresses your individual learning type.
ex.t: Lancom关心你，并针对你的个人学习类型。

ex.s: Data collected from the device could be used to recognize different participants based on how they typed, with very low error rates.
ex.t: 从设备收集的数据可用于根据参与者的打字方式识别不同的人，错误率非常低。

defs.def: to write sth using a computer or typewriter （用计算机或打字机）打字

ex.s: ■Write by hand or type on a single sheet of paper.
ex.t: ■手写或用打字机写在单张纸上。

ex.s: ■On the same sheet of paper, write or type your name, address, telephone number, and birth date.
ex.t: ■在同一张纸上，手写或打印你的姓名、地址、电话号码和出生日期。

ex.s: In a study describing the technology, the researchers had 100 volunteers type the word “touch”four times using the smart keyboard.
ex.t: 在一项描述该技术的研究中，研究人员让100名志愿者用智能键盘把“touch”这个词打了四遍。

defs.def: to find out the group or class that a person or thing belongs to 测定 … 的类型；分型；定型

ex.s: Try to work out what type of word it is (noun, adjective, verb, etc), then use the words before and after it to help you guess the meaning.
ex.t: 尝试确定它是什么类型的词(名词,形容词,动词等),然后使用它前后的词来帮助你猜测意义.

ex.s: It reminded me of blue cheese, a similarly strong smelling type o food you either love or hate.
ex.t: 它让我想起蓝纹奶酪，一种类似气味浓烈的食物，你要么爱要么恨。

ex.s: Well, actually, they speak Quebecois, which is a type of Canadian French.
ex.t: 嗯，其实他们说魁北克法语，是加拿大法语的一种。

ex.s: Finning is a type of fishing where sharks are caught and their fins cut off.
ex.t: 芬宁(芬宁語:Finning)是一种捕鲨和割去鱼鳍的钓鱼方式.

ex.s: Be prepared to be corrected by student B The classification of household waste aims to help people separate different types of waste.
ex.t: 准备好被学生B纠正 家庭垃圾分类旨在帮助人们分离不同类型的废物。
